snippet.title: Seina: A Tale Of Spirits - Official Trailer | Mundo Gamer Showcase 2026 - Edition 01
snippet.description:
Ready for a peaceful journey through a magical world?

Seina: A Tale Of Spirits is a cozy fantasy adventure about a girl searching for her lost cat in a world filled with gentle spirits and quiet mysteries.

Explore, help others, and uncover a story driven by emotion and discovery.

🛒 Add it to your Steam wishlist
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4119150/Seina_a_Tale_Of_Spirits/

🔥 About the Game

🌸 Cozy Fantasy Adventure
• Relaxing exploration in a beautiful, hand-crafted world
• A journey focused on emotion and discovery

🐾 A Heartfelt Story
• Help Mika find her lost cat, Seina
• Uncover a deeper connection to a magical world

🌿 Spirit-Filled World
• Meet adorable animal spirits with unique personalities
• Complete side quests and build connections

🧩 Light Puzzles and Exploration
• Solve environmental puzzles at your own pace
• Discover secrets across diverse regions

🎨 Hand-Painted Visuals
• Vibrant environments inspired by nature and folklore
• A soothing and immersive atmosphere

🎵 Calm and Emotional Soundtrack
• Music designed to enhance relaxation and storytelling
• A journey meant to be felt as much as played

⚠️ Content Warning
This game contains emotional themes but is suitable for most audiences, with no explicit or graphic content.
